title: VPN users disconnecting after gateway certificate renewal
details: Remote users report tunnels dropping every few minutes since the gateway certificate was renewed this morning.

title: Repeated failed SSH logins on bastion host
details: Over 400 failed SSH attempts from a single IP range in 10 minutes against the bastion host.

title: Disk usage above 90% on log server
details: Log volume on the central syslog server is at 92% and growing roughly 1% per hour.

title: Suspicious OAuth consent grant to unknown app
details: A user granted mail read permissions to an unverified third-party application. Possible phishing follow-up.

title: Ransomware note found on shared file server
details: Files on the finance share renamed with a new extension and a ransom note dropped in each folder.

title: Nightly backup job failed
details: The database backup job exited with a timeout error for the second night in a row.

title: VPN tunnel failures after certificate rotation
details: Site-to-site and remote-access tunnels failed after the intermediate certificate was rotated without updating the chain.

title: Remote access VPN portal rejecting logins
details: Portal authentication failed for all users because the LDAP bind account password expired.

title: Split-tunnel routes missing for remote users
details: Remote users could not reach internal subnets because split-tunnel routes were dropped from the gateway config.

title: IPsec tunnel to branch office flapping
details: Phase 2 renegotiation failed every hour due to mismatched lifetime settings between peers.

title: Brute-force SSH attempts from single ASN
details: Thousands of failed SSH logins from one hosting provider; blocked the range at the perimeter firewall.

title: Password spraying against email accounts
details: Low-and-slow failed logins across hundreds of mailboxes from rotating IPs. Enforced MFA and blocked legacy auth.

title: Admin credentials found in public repository
details: A service account password was committed to a public code repository. Rotated the credential and purged history.

title: Log server disk full, events dropped
details: The syslog server ran out of disk and silently dropped events for six hours. Added retention policy and alerting.

title: Database disk usage alert
details: Database volume crossed 85% after an index rebuild left temporary files behind.

title: Phishing email impersonating payroll
details: Staff received a fake payroll update email linking to a credential harvesting page. Pulled messages and reset passwords for two users who clicked.

title: Malicious OAuth app requesting mailbox access
details: An attacker-controlled app obtained consent from a user after a phishing link. Revoked the grant and blocked the app tenant-wide.

title: Ransomware encrypted workstation files
details: One workstation encrypted local files after a malicious attachment was opened. Isolated the host and restored from backup.

title: Backup job timeout on database server
details: Backups timed out because the backup window overlapped with the nightly batch job. Moved the schedule.

title: Web server TLS certificate expired
details: The public web server served an expired certificate for 40 minutes. Automated renewal was misconfigured.

title: Unexpected privilege escalation on build server
details: A CI service account was added to the local administrators group outside of change control.

title: Outbound traffic spike to unknown host
details: A server uploaded 12 GB to an unfamiliar external IP overnight. Investigated as possible data exfiltration; turned out to be a misconfigured backup target.

title: DDoS against public API
details: Request volume to the public API spiked 30x from a botnet. Enabled upstream rate limiting.

title: Malware detected on contractor laptop
details: Endpoint agent flagged a trojan on a contractor laptop connected to guest Wi-Fi. Quarantined and reimaged.

title: DNS resolution failures for internal services
details: Internal names failed to resolve after a forwarder change. Rolled back the forwarder configuration.

title: Asymmetric routing breaking firewall sessions
details: Return traffic took a different path and the firewall dropped sessions. Fixed the static route priority.

title: Unpatched critical vulnerability on file servers
details: Three file servers were missing a critical remote code execution patch. Patched with the automation pipeline.

title: Application memory leak causing restarts
details: A web worker leaked memory and restarted every four hours. Fixed an unbounded cache.

title: Service account locked out repeatedly
details: A stale scheduled task kept retrying an old password and locked the service account.

title: Firewall policy blocking payment app traffic
details: A new rule placed above the allow rule blocked the payment application. Reordered the policy.
